class.name: TraversabilityMap
class.description: Display plugin for a Traversability Map 3D.

class.name: MultiLayeredSurfaceMap
class.description: Display plugin for a Multi-Level Surface Map (MLS).
Goal tool that picks the true 3D point on the rendered MLS/traversability map (instead of the z=0 ground plane) and publishes it as PoseStamped.
Selects a polygonal region on the map; the planner node renders the allowed-orientation wedges of every partially traversable cell inside it. Right-click with no vertices clears the markers.
Appends a 3D waypoint (picked on the rendered MLS/traversability map) to the planner's waypoint queue; the queue is planned through on the next goal.
Draws a polygonal operational zone on the map. Zone properties select keep-out, caution, speed-limit, preferred, direction, or note semantics.
Field operator panel: planner/execution status, route risk, system health, pause/resume/abort/replan, mission editing, persistence, and map actions.
Click a traversability patch to show its classification, slope, cost, and permitted heading bands.
